name: Kiritani Haruka
source:
Haruka is a former member of the nationally-acclaimed idol group ASRUN. She's a charismatic girl who boasts the highest popularity rating among all the members of the group. But after the group breaks up and she leaves the show business world, she returns to school at Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy, where [url=/c128193]Minori[/url] attends.

She's part of the idol unit MORE MORE JUMP!.

[From in-game profile]
